CustomField.description: Maximum characters of article body content sent to LLM scoring prompts and AI Fix. 0 (default) = no cap — the full article body is sent. Set a positive integer to cap content length, e.g. 8000 to limit to 8000 chars. Minimum enforced when a cap is set: 1000. This field is intentionally not surfaced in the Setup Wizard — edit it directly on the KB_Scan_Config__c custom setting record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 0 = no cap (send full article). Set a positive integer to limit chars sent to the LLM (e.g. 8000). Not shown in Setup Wizard — edit KB_Scan_Config__c directly.
CustomField.label: LLM Content Char Limit
